assumptions: Considered only shipments with non-null shipped_date and delivered_date
An order is counted if any of its shipments took more than 14 days from shipped_date to delivered_date
Used julianday date difference in days
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders_over_14,
  COUNT(*) AS matching_rows
FROM shipments
WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL
  AND delivered_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date)) > 14;
